example.title: E.A. and Rebecca (Johnson) Marsh House, 833 East St. (NRHP)

brief: Painted-lady Queen Anne, 2.5 storeys: teal clapboard with a sage lower band, fish-scale shingled gables, deep red and grey trim picked out on brackets and turned porch posts. A steep front gable with a small attic window, a corner tower with a tall conical slate-grey roof and finial over a recessed second-floor balcony, and a front porch on turned red posts with a small pediment. Tall corbelled brick chimney; iron urn planter and a hedge in front.
